# content.md output

The exact, unedited `content.md` repository-agent result is saved here as
`candidate.json`. Its generator metadata distinguishes the `content.md` system
from the disclosed Codex host. This is not a claim that the currently unwired
live-provider CLI generated the language.

The committed `review-request.json` translates the frozen scenario into the
current deterministic UX-writing review contract. Its generated `review.json`
and `repair-brief.json` record what the shipped evaluator diagnosed before
candidate generation.

Do not hand-edit or repair the saved output after generation. Record the exact
tool version, host, execution path, and run identifier when available. If a
future generation fails, save a separate `run-error.json`; do not manufacture a
replacement candidate.
